additional_ablation: Envelope-only diagnostic retains full model, q and residuals; removes shared transfer roof only.
base_model: s_base=0 steady bottleneck approximation; FULL absolute errors are evaluation diagnostics, not training targets.
joint_residual_rule: Include nominal (0,0) and joint residual vector plus its reflection. Never take independent marginal extrema.
q_rule: Enumerate integer capacities within separate static ranges; cross resource scenarios conservatively, preserve common residual/transfer draws.
tie_rule: Among robust candidates within 3% of minimum nominal roofline, prefer upstream placement then lowest predicted MC service.
